title: Demo comparison ids and sweep-nudge dismissals still write to real browser storage (r2 #17 still present)
detail: In demo mode these messages reach update_inner unbranched, persisting synthetic demo ids to session/localStorage on the visitor's browser and hydrating back on re-entry. Browser-local only (no endpoint write), but it deviates from the spec's no-persistence scope guard.
recommended_fix: Intercept UserToggledComparison/UserDismissedSweepNudge in demo_update (skip the storage write) or use a demo-scoped storage key while demo_mode is True.

title: Latent: UserAcceptedPolicy is neither intercepted in demo nor guarded, and enter_demo keeps server_policy_version (r2 #31 still present)
evidence:
UserAcceptedPolicy ->
      case model.policy_reaccept_loading {
        True -> #(model, effect.none())
        False -> #(
          Model(..model, policy_reaccept_loading: True),
          auth_api.accept_policy(
            version: model.server_policy_version,
            csrf_token: model.csrf_token,
            on_response: ApiReturnedAcceptPolicy,
          ),
        )
      }
-- enter_demo spreads the prior model without resetting server_policy_version:
        Model(
          ..model,
          route:,
          auth: Success(landlord),
          csrf_token: "demo-csrf-token",
          demo_mode: True,
          demo_store: Some(store),
-- lint exemption rationale (lint_demo_network.py): "    # auth_api arms — demo mode is always False here" / "    \"UserAcceptedPolicy\","; UserAcceptedPolicy is absent from demo_update.gleam's intercepted msg imports (grep-confirmed).
detail: If a real-authed session ever navigates in-SPA to /demo, the policy modal could surface and fire a real accept_policy POST carrying the demo's bogus CSRF token. Unreachable today (no authed /demo link; hand-typed URLs boot fresh with server_policy_version "") and fails closed server-side on CSRF mismatch, so latent only.
recommended_fix: Set server_policy_version to "" in enter_demo, or intercept UserAcceptedPolicy in demo_update.handle so the lint's 'demo mode is always False here' assumption holds by construction.
